changelog.detail: Keep a Changelog format with a released section

ci_configuration.detail: runs tests, coverage, bench and secret scan on every push

deployment_manifests.detail: container image definition, non-root user, read-only rootfs

packaging.detail: PEP 621 metadata, src layout, console_scripts entry point

qualification_environment_pinned.detail: hash-pinned, so qualification is repeatable byte for byte

reproducible_tests.detail: pytest suite, deterministic seeds, no network fixture required

rerunnable_verification.detail: one command reproduces every number in BENCH.json

evidence.ladder: ML Technology Readiness Level, Lavin et al. 2022 (TMLR)
evidence.trL9_reason: requires proven success in an operational environment, which cannot be asserted from a repository
